question:
**Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Central character in a story or play
solution:
The correct answer is 'Protagonist.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 'Protagonist'- the central or main character in a story or play.(किसी कहानी या नाटक का केंद्रीय या मुख्य पात्र)

 
 
• Example:* *The protagonist of the play is a typical colonist.
 
 
 
• Let's see the meanings of the other words:-
 
• **Emulator**- a** person or thing that imitates**.(वह व्यक्ति या वस्तु जो नकल करता हो)​
 
 
• Example: Until quite recently, **emulators** copied the behaviors of those higher in the social scale than themselves.
 
 
 
• **Adversary**- a**n enemy, or an opponent in a competition**.(कोई शत्रु, या किसी प्रतियोगिता में प्रतिद्वंद्वी)
 
 
• Example:* *He defeated his old **adversary**.
 
 
 
• **Contender**- a** person or group competing with others to achieve something**.(कोई व्यक्ति या समूह कुछ हासिल करने के लिए दूसरों से प्रतिस्पर्धा कर रहा हो)​
 
 
• Example: She was a strong **contender** for Britain's Olympic team.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is 'option 2'.
